Callout.Name: Contraband Phone - Cell Search
Callout.Message: Phone found during a cell search.
Callout.Advisory: Inmate identified, cell shared with two others.

Script.Line: It was in a book with the middle cut out of it.
It is not mine. It was in the cell, not on me.
Three of us live in there. Ask them.

Lines.Approach: It came out of a hollowed book and it has been used tonight.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
